method: All 260 existing links checked against YouTube public player metadata. Candidate titles and uploaders verified via YouTube oEmbed; complete playthroughs/longplays prioritized. No video downloads.
limitations: After the original audit, YouTube watch pages returned an unusual-traffic challenge. Further watch-page requests stopped; supported oEmbed metadata and independent indexed evidence were used for alternatives.
Exact duration is not available for every replacement. A missing after.seconds value is unknown, not zero; no guessed runtime is shown in the catalog.
Demo, beta, naturally short games, and localized title variants were reviewed individually. Not every short link has a verified replacement.
